crossRefs.note: Now I Paul, myself, entreat you by the humility and gentleness of Christ, I who in your presence am lowly among you…
Yes, I beg you that I may not, when present, show courage with the confidence with which I intend to be bold against…
For, “His letters”, they say, “are weighty and strong, but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech is despised.”
For this cause I write these things while absent, that I may not deal sharply when present, according to the authority…
Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they the offspring of Abraham? So am I.
For we are the circumcision, who worship God in the Spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the…
That which I speak, I don’t speak according to the Lord, but as in foolishness, in this confidence of boasting.
Are they servants of Christ? (I speak as one beside himself.) I am more so: in labors more abundantly, in prisons more…

translations.web: I speak by way of disparagement, as though we had been weak. Yet in whatever way anyone is bold (I speak in foolishness), I am bold also.
translations.bsb: To my shame I concede that we were too weak for that! Speaking as a fool, however, I can match what anyone else dares to boast about.
translations.kjv: I speak as concerning reproach, as though we had been weak. Howbeit whereinsoever any is bold, (I speak foolishly,) I am bold also.
translations.asv: I speak by way of disparagement, as though we had been weak. Yet whereinsoever any is bold (I speak in foolishness), I am bold also.
